visibleTraits: Separate green leaf blades on petioles, with varied pointed/arrow-like or oval blades; loose leaves, not a cabbage/lettuce head.
Leafy crop identity should be readable without lettering; do not use a single generic heart-shaped leaf as the whole evidence.
Avoid implying all cultivars have identical leaf margins or red roots.
limits: Illustrated exemplars, not universal cultivar/species determination.
The source historical アカザ科 label is separate; do not silently publish or close modern botanical classification from this asset.

visibleTraits: Rounded swollen bulb with papery brown/golden outer tunic, narrower dry neck and basal root area.
Distinguishable from a garlic clove cluster, round potato and daikon.
Whole bulb should remain the main visible subject and not be cropped beyond recognition.
limits: One brown/yellow onion example does not mean all onions share this skin color.
Source root-vegetable grouping is a utilization category; bulb is not redefined as a true root.
Historical ユリ科 source label remains a separate classification hold.

visibleTraits: Long pale/white tapering storage root with green leaf crown; distinguish broad root from slender fibrous roots.
Root and crown should connect anatomically, with readable narrowing tip.
Avoid orange carrot color, round turnip silhouette or an onion-like bulb.
limits: Example daikon form, not universal cultivar geometry or harvest maturity standard.
No disease diagnosis or pesticide/use claim.

finalAssetReview.finding: Long pale root tapers to a narrow end with fine root hairs; lobed green crown connects to the top. Distinct from orange carrot, round turnip and onion bulb. JA alt/observation match the pale thick-to-thin portion and leaf side. Main root and identifying outline readable; extreme terminal hair lies near the lower edge, so later responsive framing must preserve the subject.
